arguments.name: target
arguments.description: the project file(s) or directory paths to analyze

options.name: --limit
options.description: fails if total libyears behind is greater than this  value

options.name: --limit-any
options.description: fails if any dependency is more libyears behind than this  value

options.name: --limit-project
options.description: fails if any project's total libyears behind is  greater than this value

options.name: --recursive
options.description: search recursively for all compatible files, even if one  is found in a directory passed as an argument
